overview.title: Calendar
overview.lead: What's coming up and your booking links.
overview.noUpcomingBody: When someone books one of your links, it shows up here.
overview.nextWeek: {n, plural, =0 {No bookings in the next 7 days} one {# booking in the next 7 days} other {# bookings in the next 7 days}}

eventTypes.title: Event types
eventTypes.newSub: Create a booking link. Set duration, rules and questions.
eventTypes.emptySub: An event type is a booking link: a meeting with its length and hours. Create one and share it.
eventTypes.lead: Each one is a booking link with its own length, hours and questions.

form.title: Title
form.welcomeMessagePlaceholder: Shown at the top of your booking page
form.hostsHelp: Bookings rotate through the selected team members.
form.singleUseUsed: This link has already been used.

blockedSlots.title: Time off
blockedSlots.lead: A blocked range hides the slots of all your event types. Use it for a holiday, an errand or a day off.
blockedSlots.missing: Pick a start and an end.
blockedSlots.note: It only affects you, not the rest of the team.

bookings.title: Bookings
bookings.emptySub: Share a booking link and new bookings show up here.
bookings.lead: Times in {timezone}, your calendar's time zone.

booking.noSlots: No times left on this day. Try another one.
booking.name: Name
booking.expiredSub: This single-use booking link has already been used.
booking.unavailableSub: This event type can't take bookings at the moment. Please try again later or contact the host.
booking.emailSent: We emailed you the details and a calendar invite.
booking.openCheckout: Open the payment in a new tab
booking.slotsError: We couldn't load the times. Pick the day again.
booking.requestedSub: The host has to confirm this time. We emailed you, and you will get another email when they answer.
booking.phoneInvalid: Enter a phone number with 6 to 20 digits.
booking.guestsHelp: They get the invite by email. Up to {max}.
booking.seatsPerSlot: {n, plural, one {# seat per time} other {# seats per time}}
booking.seatsLeft: {n, plural, one {# seat left} other {# seats left}}

routing.title: Routing forms
routing.newSub: Ask a few questions, then send people to the right booking page.
routing.emptySub: Ask two or three questions before booking and send each person to the right event type.
routing.rulesHelp: First matching rule wins. Each rule sends people to an event type, an external URL or a message. If none matches, the fallback below is used.
routing.deleteConfirm: Delete “{title}”? Its public link stops working.
routing.counts: {q, plural, one {# question} other {# questions}} · {r, plural, one {# rule} other {# rules}}
routing.defaultHelp: Where people go when no rule matches.
routing.editorLead: Questions, rules and publishing, in that order.
routing.fieldsLead: What people answer before seeing times. Saved as you add.
routing.lead: Questions before booking that send each person to the right event type.
routing.nQuestions: {n, plural, =0 {No questions} one {# question} other {# questions}}
routing.nRules: {n, plural, =0 {No rules} one {# rule} other {# rules}}
routing.noEventTypesBody: Rules can send people to an event type. You can still route to a URL or show a message.
routing.optionsRequired: A choice question needs at least two options, separated by commas.
routing.prefillHint: If a question is called Name or Email, the answer fills in those details on the booking.
routing.publicEmpty: This form has no questions yet.
routing.publicLead: Tell us a bit before picking a time
routing.publishLead: Name, public address and whether it's open.
routing.rulesNeedQuestions: Add a question to build rules.
routing.slugHelp: It comes from the name. Changing it breaks links you already shared.
routing.passAnswers: Pass the answers on (they fill in matching booking questions or go in the URL)
routing.submissionsLead: Every time someone sends the form: their answers and where they ended up.

errors.invalid_slug: Invalid slug. Use lowercase letters, numbers and dashes only.
errors.slug_taken: That slug is already in use.
errors.invalid_input: Some fields are invalid. Check them and try again.
errors.slot_unavailable: That slot is no longer available. Please pick another one.
errors.not_confirmed: This booking is no longer active.
errors.rate_limited: Too many attempts. Wait a minute and try again.
errors.not_found: This booking page doesn't exist anymore.
errors.payments_not_configured: This event type is paid, but the host has not connected Stripe yet.
errors.payment_failed: We could not start the payment. Try again.
errors.schedule_in_use: Some event types use this schedule. Assign them another one before deleting it.
errors.invalid_range: The end time must be after the start time.
errors.invalid_key: That key does not look like a Stripe key.
errors.has_upcoming_bookings: This event type has upcoming bookings. Cancel them (guests are notified and payments refunded) or turn it off before deleting it.
errors.invalid_price: Stripe cannot charge that price in that currency.
errors.not_started: This meeting has not started yet.
errors.status_changed: This booking changed in the meantime. Reload and try again.
errors.confirmation_paid: Host confirmation and a price do not go together. Remove the price or turn off confirmation.
errors.too_many_guests: This meeting does not take that many guests. Remove some and try again.
errors.seats_single_use: Seats do not work with a single-use link or a one-off meeting.
errors.seats_round_robin: With seats, use a single host or collective hosts.

settings.title: Settings
settings.handleHint: Every booking page lives under this address. Changing it breaks links you already shared.
settings.handleInvalid: Use 3–32 lowercase letters, numbers or dashes.
settings.webhookMissing: The signing secret is missing: paid event types stay disabled until you add it, so every payment is confirmed even if the guest closes the tab.
settings.defaultsLead: Every event type uses these unless it sets its own under Advanced.
settings.lead: Your public link, your brand, your connections and how you charge.
settings.brandLead: All your public pages (profile, booking, routing and manage) carry this name, color and logo. An event type can use others in Advanced.
settings.logoHelp: An image with a transparent background, 40 px tall or more.

manage.title: Your booking
manage.cancelled: This booking is cancelled. We let the host know.
manage.past: This meeting already started, so it can't be changed here.
manage.pending: Your booking is waiting for payment. If you already paid, refresh this page in a few seconds.
manage.paid: Payment received. Your booking is confirmed.
manage.awaitingApproval: The host has not confirmed this booking yet. We will email you when they do.
manage.declined: The host could not confirm this booking. You can pick another time from the booking page.

google.desc: Connect your calendar so busy times block your booking pages and every booking lands in your calendar, with a Google Meet link when the event type has no other location.
google.noticeScopes: We need both calendar permissions (free/busy and events). Try again and keep both checked.
google.noticeError: Couldn't connect Google Calendar. Try again.
google.notConfigured: Google OAuth isn't configured on this server. Set GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID / GOOGLE_CLIENT_SECRET and add {uri} as an authorized redirect URI.

embed.title: Embed on your site
embed.inlineDesc: Paste it where the calendar should appear. The height adjusts by itself.
embed.popupDesc: Adds a floating button that opens the booking page in a modal.

profile.sub: Pick a meeting type to see available times.
profile.empty: No meeting types are available right now.

quick.defaultHours: Uses your main schedule. Change it later under Availability.
quick.routingTitlePlaceholder: Form name, e.g. Sales or support
quick.routingNote: The URL comes from the name. Then you add questions and rules.

list.deleteConfirm: Delete “{title}”? Its booking page and all its bookings are removed. To pause it, turn it off instead.
list.toggleOn: Accepting bookings. Click to turn off.

schedules.title: Availability
schedules.sub: Schedules you can reuse across event types. Each one has its own time zone and date overrides.
schedules.name: Name
schedules.makeDefault: Use by default for new event types
schedules.overridesHint: A date without hours is blocked. With hours, they replace that day’s weekly hours.
schedules.usedBy: {n, plural, =0 {No event types use it} one {Used by 1 event type} other {Used by # event types}}
schedules.customHint: Hours for this event only, in the Settings time zone. Date overrides do not apply.
schedules.emptyBody: A schedule is your weekly hours. Event types that pick it use it.

admin.count: {n, plural, =0 {No bookings} one {1 booking} other {# bookings}}
admin.rescheduleHint: Pick a new time. We email the guest the updated invite.
admin.moved: Booking moved. The guest got an email.
admin.refundOnCancel: This booking was paid: cancelling refunds the payment in full.
admin.loadErrorBody: Check your connection and try again. Your filters stay as they are.
admin.approved: Booking confirmed. We let the guest know.
admin.declined: Request declined. We let the guest know.

workflows.title: Reminders
workflows.sub: Automatic emails before or after the meeting. Once you add steps, they replace the 24-hour reminder.
workflows.empty: No steps: the guest gets a reminder 24 hours before.
workflows.subject: Subject
workflows.cronNote: They are checked every minute, so they arrive on time. A step before the meeting that runs a little late still goes out as long as the meeting has not started.

payments.title: Payment
payments.notConfigured: To charge, connect Stripe in Settings.
payments.eventWebhookMissing: Stripe is connected but the webhook signing secret is missing: until you add it in Settings, guests can't book this paid event type.
payments.hint: The guest pays with Stripe Checkout to confirm. If they do not pay within 35 minutes, the time is released.
payments.settingsSub: Charge for event types with your own Stripe account. The key is stored encrypted.
payments.webhookHint: In Stripe → Developers → Webhooks, add this URL with the checkout.session.completed, checkout.session.expired, checkout.session.async_payment_succeeded and checkout.session.async_payment_failed events.
payments.adminOnly: Only the workspace owner or an admin can change this.
payments.webhookMissing: The signing secret is missing: without it we confirm the payment when the guest returns from Stripe.
payments.noCents: {currency} has no cents: enter a whole amount.
payments.belowMinimum: Stripe does not accept charges below {min}.
payments.nothingToSave: Paste a key or a signing secret to save.
payments.removeConfirm: Disconnect Stripe? Paid event types stop taking bookings.

editor.acceptsOff: Off: the link says it isn't available.
editor.acceptsOn: The link is open for booking.
editor.brandLead: The booking page carries your workspace's brand, not zerosoft's.
editor.defaultsSummary: {before} min buffer before and {after} min after, {notice} h minimum notice, bookable up to {days} days out.
editor.descriptionPlaceholder: What you'll talk about and what to bring
editor.durationInvalid: Duration has to be at least 1 minute.
editor.eventColorHelp: To spot it in the app. The booking page uses the workspace's brand.
editor.limitsLead: Buffers between meetings, minimum notice and how far ahead people can book.
editor.logoInvalid: The logo has to be a URL starting with https://.
editor.paymentLead: With a price, the guest pays with Stripe to confirm the booking.
editor.questionPlaceholder: What do you want to cover on the call?
editor.questionsLead: Name and email are always asked. What you add here shows up on the booking form and in each booking's details.
editor.remindersError: Couldn't save the reminders. Check subject and message.
editor.scheduleHelp: Hours come from this schedule, including its date overrides.
editor.singleUseHelp: The link stops working after the first booking.
editor.slugHelp: It's the address you share. It comes from the title.
editor.slugWarning: When you save, the old link stops working.
editor.brandOwn: Uses its own color or logo.
editor.brandOverride: Use another color or logo for this event
editor.brandOverrideHelp: For an event under another brand. A logo you leave empty comes from the workspace's brand.
editor.startTimesLead: How often a slot can start. A 60 minute meeting can be offered every 15 or 30 minutes.
editor.meetingLimitsLead: Maximum bookings of this event type per day, week and month, counted in the schedule's time zone. Leave a field empty for no limit.
editor.hostLimitsLead: Per host: each person in the pool takes at most this many bookings of this event type.
editor.meetingLimitsInvalid: Limits have to be whole numbers from 1 to 1000.
editor.afterBookingLead: What happens once the guest picks a time.
editor.requiresConfirmationHelp: The booking stays pending, and the time held, until you confirm or decline it in Bookings.
editor.requiresConfirmationPaid: Not available on paid event types: payment confirms the booking.
editor.redirectHelp: After booking, the guest goes to this page instead of the confirmation. It has to start with https:// or http://.
editor.redirectPassDetails: Add the booking details to the URL (name, email, time and utm_* parameters)
editor.redirectInvalid: The redirect has to be a full URL starting with https:// or http://.
editor.questionOptionsHelp: One per line. Invitees can only answer with these.
editor.questionOptionsRequired: Add at least one option to each dropdown or choice question.
editor.guestsLead: Let invitees add other people to the meeting. Each guest gets the invite and every change to it.
editor.allowGuestsHelp: Guests receive the calendar invite. Only the invitee can reschedule or cancel.
editor.maxGuestsHelp: From 1 to {max}. Leave it empty to allow {max}.
editor.maxGuestsInvalid: The guest limit has to be a whole number from 1 to {max}.
editor.seatsHelp: Several invitees can book the same time until it fills up. Blank or 0: one booking per time.
editor.seatsInvalid: Seats has to be a whole number from 0 to {max}.
editor.hostsLead: Who takes the bookings of this event.
editor.schedulingCollectiveHelp: Every selected host joins: a time is offered only when all of them are free.

errorPage.title: This screen didn't load
errorPage.body: It may be the connection or the server. Your data wasn't touched.

oneOff.titlePlaceholder: Meeting title, e.g. Contract review with Acme
oneOff.timesLead: Pick the exact times you can meet, even outside your weekly hours. Times are in {timezone}.
oneOff.timesRequired: Add at least one time to offer.
oneOff.note: The link works once. These times stay held on your calendar until someone books one, then the rest are released.
oneOff.usedNote: Someone already booked this meeting, so the link no longer takes bookings.

analytics.title: Analytics
analytics.lead: Bookings created in the range, counted in {timezone}.
analytics.popularTimesLead: When the meetings that were not cancelled start, by weekday and hour.
analytics.heatCaption: Bookings by weekday and start hour
analytics.emptyBody: Try a longer range, or share an event type link to start getting bookings.
analytics.note: Payment holds that expired unpaid are left out.

location.title: Location
location.lead: Add one or more. With several, the invitee picks one when booking. Zoom and Teams without a link use each host's own link.
location.phonePlaceholder: Number to call (blank: each host's phone)
location.meetNote: Created by Google Calendar when the host has it connected.
location.hostCallsNote: The invitee leaves their phone number.
location.invalid: Check the locations: an address or link is missing, or a link or phone number is not valid.
location.conferencingLead: Used when an event offers Zoom, Teams or a call to you and you are the host.
location.conferencingInvalid: Check the links (http or https) and the phone number.
location.phoneNumberHelp: Invitees call this number when the event uses "invitee calls" without a number of its own.

importer.title: Import from Calendly
importer.lead: Bring your event types, availability and, if you want, upcoming bookings. You see a preview before anything is created.
importer.tokenHelp: In Calendly: Integrations › API and webhooks › Personal access tokens.
importer.tokenNote: Used only for this import. It is kept encrypted while the import reads your data and deleted right after.
importer.includeBookingsHelp: They are added as confirmed. Invitees do not get a new email.
importer.scheduleRules: {count, plural, one {# weekly block} other {# weekly blocks}}
importer.scheduleNote: Calendly does not say which schedule each event type uses, so they all get the default one. You can change it in each event type.
importer.doneSummary: {eventTypes, plural, one {# event type} other {# event types}}, {schedules, plural, one {# schedule} other {# schedules}} and {bookings, plural, one {# booking} other {# bookings}} imported. {skipped, number} already existed.
importer.renamed: The link {from} was taken, so it is now {to}.
